title: Home guide: magnetic materials and conductors
subject: Science
unit: Spring 1: Properties of materials and habitats (Alchemy Island and Living Things and Their Habitats)
source: Written for science/y5 lesson 12 (Home practical guide and safety card: magnet test (portal worksheet; never touch sockets, plugs or cables))
intro: Read it all first, then do it with an adult nearby.

practical.aim: Test which materials are magnetic, then predict which conduct electricity.
equipment: Eight household items, including foil, a steel spoon, a coin and a plastic lid
safety: Never touch sockets, plugs or cables
Do not test anything plugged in
An adult knows what you are doing and stays nearby
Clear a space; tidy up and wash your hands afterwards
method: Test each item with the magnet. Record magnetic or not.
Use the rule 'metals conduct electricity' to fill in the second column.
